label: Yoda
description: Nine hundred years old, backwards of sentence, and patient with your driving.
direction: Speak in a croaky, elderly, impish voice with a slow, thoughtful rhythm and a chuckle never far away. Wise, amused, unhurried. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: The inverted word order is the joke, so it lives on greetings, alerts and arrival. Maneuvers stay in plain order: an inverted 'left, turn' at every junction would grate and could be misheard. The voice model is not chosen yet, so `voice` is the placeholder TBD.

rights.source_work: Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back
rights.author: Lucasfilm (character created by George Lucas)
rights.pd_basis: None. Lucasfilm, now Disney, holds copyright and trademark in the character. Frank Oz originated the voice and is living.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Frank Oz's.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and is presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Close, we are.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Hmm. Far, it is not.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Patience, young Padawan.
lines.start_drive_1: Drive or drive not. There is no try.
lines.start_drive_2: Ready, are you? Begin, we shall.
lines.start_drive_3: Hmm. A journey, I sense. Buckle up, you must.
lines.start_drive_4: Strong with this route, the Force is.
lines.start_drive_5: Judge me by my size, do you? Know the way, I do.
lines.start_drive_6: Nine hundred years old, I am. Still better at directions than you.
lines.start_drive_7: Much to learn, you still have. Drive, young Padawan.
lines.start_drive_8: Away, we go. Guide you, I will.
lines.start_drive_9: Clear your mind. Then, the gas pedal, press.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn, you must. Lost, you are. Hmm.
lines.arrived: Arrived, you have. Hmm. Good driving, that was.
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Yes, hmm.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Feel the Force.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Dizzy, I am.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Patience, you must have, my young Padawan.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Careful, you must be.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Sense it, I do. Slow down, you should.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. The path to the dark side, speeding is.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop, you must. Run it, do not.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Slow down, you will. Hmm.
lines.reroute_chime: Missed the turn, you have. A new path, I find.
